title: Equinix 据报在新加坡签署 11.5MW 虚拟购电协议
titleEn: Equinix is reported to have signed an 11.5 MW virtual PPA in Singapore
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 18 日报道称，Equinix 与 Flo Energy 签署虚拟购电协议，初始对应至少 11.5MW 的工商业屋顶太阳能，并可选择扩至 50MW。报道还称 Equinix 在新加坡的已签约可再生能源总量达到 215MW，相关协议预计 2028 年上线。当前未找到 Equinix 或 Flo Energy 对本协议的对应公开发布；11.5MW 是报道中的 PPA 规模，不是数据中心 IT 负荷、上电容量或已交付电量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 18 that Equinix signed a virtual PPA with Flo Energy for at least 11.5 MW from commercial and industrial rooftop solar, with an option to expand to 50 MW. It also reported that Equinix's contracted renewable portfolio in Singapore reaches 215 MW and is expected online in 2028. No matching public announcement for this agreement was located from Equinix or Flo Energy. The 11.5 MW is reported PPA scale, not data-center IT load, energized capacity or delivered energy.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 协议原文待核验
officialResponse: 截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到 Equinix 或 Flo Energy 对该 11.5MW 协议的对应公开发布。
officialResponseEn: By this scan's cutoff, no matching public release for the 11.5 MW agreement had been located from Equinix or Flo Energy.
sourceNote: DCD 页面仅显示 8 月 18 日，未显示发稿时刻或时区。11.5MW、50MW 选择权和 215MW 组合规模均为单一媒体转述；2028 年为预期上线时间。
sourceNoteEn: The DCD page shows August 18 but no publication time or timezone. The 11.5 MW, 50 MW option and 215 MW portfolio figures are single-source reporting; 2028 is an expected online date.

title: Vantage Data Centers据报探索千亿美元估值IPO或出售方案
titleEn: Vantage Data Centers is reported to be exploring a $100B-valuation IPO or sale
summary: Reuters 8月13日报道，Vantage Data Centers正探索最早于2027年进行首次公开募股或出售，估值或约为1000亿美元。该报道引述未具名消息人士；截至本轮扫描截止时间，未见交易条款、发行规模、潜在买方、启动时间表，或任何会改变Vantage已公布数据中心容量、建设或投运状态的公司公告。本条只记录媒体报道，不将估值视为成交金额、已筹资金或新增基础设施资本开支。
summaryEn: Reuters reported on August 13 that Vantage Data Centers is exploring an initial public offering or sale as early as 2027 at a valuation of around $100 billion. The report cites unnamed sources; by this scan's cutoff, no transaction terms, offering size, potential buyer, launch timetable or company announcement changing Vantage's disclosed data-center capacity, construction or service status had been located. This item records the media report only and does not treat the valuation as deal value, raised capital or new infrastructure capital expenditure.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 交易路径待披露
officialResponse: 截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到 Vantage Data Centers 对IPO或出售探索的公开公告，也未找到可确认交易选择、估值、融资或时间表的监管文件。
officialResponseEn: By this scan's cutoff, no public Vantage Data Centers announcement or regulatory filing was located to confirm an IPO or sale process, valuation, financing or timetable.
sourceNote: 核心交易可能性、约1000亿美元估值及最早2027年的时间表来自 Reuters 单一报道，原文有访问限制。条目保留为 Rumor Watch，等待公司、交易文件或其他独立来源的实质确认。
sourceNoteEn: The possible transaction, approximately $100 billion valuation and earliest-2027 timing come from a single Reuters report with access limitations. The item remains in Rumor Watch pending a material confirmation from the company, transaction documents or another independent source.

title: Sunrun 据报向 Voltus 的数据中心 BYOC 计划提供分布式能源容量
titleEn: Sunrun is reported to supply distributed capacity to Voltus's data-center BYOC program
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 18 日报道称，Sunrun 与 Voltus 合作，从 PJM 与 MISO 地区部分户用光储系统为 Voltus 的 Bring Your Own Capacity（BYOC）计划提供容量，面向 AI 数据中心开发商。报道未披露本协议的可认证容量、客户、期限、具体并网或公用事业审批；它不能证明任何数据中心已提前获批或已获得可用电力。此前 Sunrun、Renew Home 与 Tesla 的 16GW 框架及 Google–Voltus 100MW 协议是不同安排，不能并入本协议。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 18 that Sunrun and Voltus will use a portion of residential solar-plus-storage systems in PJM and MISO for Voltus's Bring Your Own Capacity (BYOC) program for AI data-center developers. The report does not disclose accredited capacity, customer, term, specific interconnection or utility approval, so it does not establish that any data center is approved early or has available power. The prior Sunrun/Renew Home/Tesla 16 GW framework and Google–Voltus 100 MW agreement are separate arrangements and are not combined with this deal.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 可认证容量与客户待披露
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · accredited capacity and customers undisclosed
officialResponse: 截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到 Sunrun 或 Voltus 对本轮 BYOC 合作披露的容量、客户、期限或公用事业审批文件。
officialResponseEn: By this scan's cutoff, no Sunrun or Voltus document had been located that discloses capacity, customers, term or utility approvals for this BYOC partnership.
sourceNote: DCD 页面仅显示 8 月 18 日，未显示发稿时刻或时区。该报道把本协议与既有项目并列说明，但没有给出本轮合同的容量；不要把其推断为已获并网或保供。
sourceNoteEn: The DCD page shows August 18 but no publication time or timezone. It provides no capacity for this agreement; do not infer an interconnection award or firm power supply from its comparison with prior arrangements.

title: Relativity Networks 据报获 2,200 万美元融资，并拿下未具名 hyperscaler 的 4,000 万美元合同
titleEn: Relativity Networks is reported to have raised $22M and landed a $40M contract with an unnamed hyperscaler
summary: Light Reading 8 月 20 日报道称，空芯光纤公司 Relativity Networks 获得 2,200 万美元融资，并取得一份来自未具名 hyperscaler 的 4,000 万美元订单。该报道链接到 PR Newswire 同日刊载的公司供稿，但截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到 Relativity Networks 自有网站、客户或监管文件对客户身份、合同范围、交付时间、路由或部署容量的直接披露。4,000 万美元是报道所称合同金额，不是数据中心容量、已交付设备或已投运网络。
summaryEn: Light Reading reported on August 20 that hollow-core-fiber company Relativity Networks raised $22 million and secured a $40 million order from an unnamed hyperscaler. The report links to a same-day company-supplied release carried by PR Newswire, but by this scan's cutoff no directly hosted Relativity Networks, customer or regulatory record was located for the customer identity, contract scope, delivery timing, route or deployed capacity. The $40 million is the reported contract value, not data-center capacity, delivered equipment or an operating network.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 客户、合同范围与部署待核验
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · customer, contract scope and deployment unverified
officialResponse: Relativity Networks 的公开主页说明其 ChronoCore 空芯光纤平台及与 Prysmian 的制造合作，但截至本轮扫描截止时间未找到对应融资或合同的自有站点公告；未找到未具名客户的公开回应。
officialResponseEn: Relativity Networks' public site describes its ChronoCore hollow-core-fiber platform and manufacturing relationship with Prysmian, but no matching company-hosted financing or contract announcement was located by this scan's cutoff; no public response was located from the unnamed customer.
sourceNote: Light Reading 是本条唯一独立媒体来源。其链接的 PR Newswire 为公司供稿分发版本，未替代直接公司、客户或监管披露；不得由合同金额推算网络长度、数据中心容量或投运状态。
sourceNoteEn: Light Reading is this item's only independent media source. Its linked PR Newswire page is a company-supplied distribution version, not a substitute for a direct company, customer or regulatory disclosure; the contract value must not be converted into route length, data-center capacity or operating status.

title: CVC DIF 据报收购德国数据中心运营商 Firstcolo
titleEn: CVC DIF is reported to have acquired German data-center operator Firstcolo
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 14 日报道称，CVC DIF 收购德国数据中心运营商 Firstcolo；报道称其在法兰克福有两处设施，另有一处在开发。报道未披露交易对价、交割状态、融资条款、客户、机柜、MW 或运营容量，也未找到 CVC DIF、Firstcolo 或监管方的对应公告。本条只记录媒体报道，不把设施数量换算为交易容量或完成并购。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 14 that CVC DIF acquired German data-center operator Firstcolo, which it described as having two Frankfurt facilities and another under development. The report does not disclose consideration, closing status, financing, customers, racks, megawatts or operating capacity, and no corresponding announcement was located from CVC DIF, Firstcolo or a regulator. This item records the media report only and does not convert facility count into transaction capacity or a completed deal.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 交易条款与交割状态待披露
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · transaction terms and closing status undisclosed
officialResponse: 截至本轮复核，未找到交易双方或监管方对该收购的公开确认、对价或交割文件。
officialResponseEn: By this review, no public confirmation, consideration or closing document was located from the counterparties or a regulator.
sourceNote: Firstcolo 的设施数量和交易本身均来自 Data Center Dynamics 单一报道；不得据此推断 MW、收入或已完成交割。
sourceNoteEn: Both the reported transaction and Firstcolo facility count come from a single Data Center Dynamics report; they do not establish megawatts, revenue or a completed closing.

title: Mubadala 据报考虑投资日本秋田 Bitgrit 与 S2 的 500MW 数据中心项目
titleEn: Mubadala is reported to be considering an investment in Bitgrit and S2's 500 MW Akita data-center project
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 19 日报道称，阿联酋 Mubadala 正考虑投资 Bitgrit 与 S2 位于日本秋田的 500MW 数据中心项目，并称较小的 1.5MW 部署预计明年落地。报道使用的是“考虑投资”，未找到 Mubadala、Bitgrit、S2 或当地主管机构对投资、约束性协议、土地、供电、许可、客户或交付时间的对应公开确认。500MW 因此只是单一报道中的拟议项目规模，不能表述为已获融资、已锁定电力、在建或可用容量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 19 that UAE-based Mubadala is considering an investment in a 500 MW Bitgrit and S2 data-center project in Akita, Japan, and that a smaller 1.5 MW deployment is expected next year. The report describes a considered investment; no matching public confirmation was located from Mubadala, Bitgrit, S2 or a local authority for an investment, binding agreement, land, power, permits, customers or delivery timing. The 500 MW is therefore only the proposed-project scale in one report, not financed, secured-power, under-construction or available capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 投资与项目基础条件待核验
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · investment and project prerequisites unverified
officialResponse: 截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到 Mubadala、Bitgrit、S2 或秋田当地主管机构对投资或项目条件的对应公开公告。
officialResponseEn: By this scan's cutoff, no matching public announcement on the investment or project prerequisites was located from Mubadala, Bitgrit, S2 or an Akita local authority.
sourceNote: 500MW、考虑投资及 1.5MW 明年部署均来自 DCD 单一报道；缺少交易、土地、供电、许可、客户和建设文件。
sourceNoteEn: The 500 MW, considered investment and 1.5 MW next-year deployment all come from one DCD report; transaction, land, power, permit, customer and construction records are absent.

title: Fundamental Data 位于西弗吉尼亚州的 Ridgeline 数据与能源项目据报通过场址控制核验
titleEn: Fundamental Data's West Virginia Ridgeline data-and-energy project is reported to have cleared a site-control review
summary: POWER Magazine 8 月 18 日报道称，西弗吉尼亚州环境保护部空气质量处已认定 Fundamental Data 满足 Ridgeline Facility 既有空气质量许可的场址控制要求。报道将该设施描述为一个拟含燃气、光伏和数据中心的 5GW 级综合项目的首期。Fundamental Data 的公开项目页仅概述其已走过监管审查和空气质量委员会确认流程，未提供本次场址控制认定的日期化文件；5GW 也不是已许可、在建、并网或投运的数据中心容量。
summaryEn: POWER Magazine reported on August 18 that West Virginia's Department of Environmental Protection Division of Air Quality determined that Fundamental Data satisfied site-control requirements for the existing Ridgeline Facility air-quality permit. The report describes the facility as the first phase of a proposed 5 GW gas, solar and data-center complex. Fundamental Data's public project page outlines a regulatory process and Air Quality Board confirmation, but does not provide a dated document for this reported site-control determination; 5 GW is not permitted, under-construction, interconnected or operating data-center capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 场址控制文件待核验
entities: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection
officialResponse: Fundamental Data 的公开项目页称项目已完成环境监管审查并获空气质量委员会确认，但未找到对应本次场址控制认定的日期化官方文件。
officialResponseEn: Fundamental Data's public project page says the project completed environmental review and received Air Quality Board confirmation, but no dated official document for the reported site-control determination was located.
sourceNote: 当前场址控制认定及 5GW 项目描述来自 POWER Magazine 单一报道；既有空气许可不等同于数据中心已获全部许可、建成、并网或投运。
sourceNoteEn: The current site-control determination and 5 GW project description come from one POWER Magazine report; an existing air permit does not establish full data-center permitting, construction, interconnection or operations.

title: Globalinx 据报购地扩展弗吉尼亚海滩海缆登陆站园区
titleEn: Globalinx is reported to have bought land to expand its Virginia Beach cable-landing-station campus
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 18 日报道称，Globalinx 购入土地以扩展其位于弗吉尼亚州 Virginia Beach 的 cable landing station（CLS）数据中心园区；报道同时提到当地官员正考虑数据中心暂停措施。公开线索未披露地块面积、交易对价、用电/IT 容量、规划批准、融资、客户或建设时间，因此不能把购地等同于已获批或可用的数据中心容量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 18 that Globalinx bought land to expand its Virginia Beach cable-landing-station (CLS) data-center campus, and noted that local officials are considering a data-center moratorium. The public lead does not disclose parcel size, consideration, power or IT capacity, planning approval, financing, customers or construction timing, so land acquisition does not establish approved or available data-center capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 购地与规划细节待核验
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · land and planning details unverified
officialResponse: 截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到 Globalinx、土地登记机构或 Virginia Beach 对本次购地及扩园的对应公开确认。
officialResponseEn: By this scan's cutoff, no matching public confirmation of this land purchase and expansion was located from Globalinx, a land-record authority or Virginia Beach.
sourceNote: 购地、扩园与地方暂停措施背景均来自 DCD 单一报道；缺少面积、MW、许可和交易文件。
sourceNoteEn: The reported land purchase, expansion and local-moratorium context all come from one DCD report; parcel size, megawatts, permits and transaction records are absent.

title: 英国西伦敦一处最高 5 万平方米数据中心据报获建设批准
titleEn: A data center of up to 50,000 square meters in west London is reported to have received construction approval
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 14 日报道称，英国西伦敦一处项目已获建设批准；其转述规划文件称项目最多约 5 万平方米、用电 64MW、关键 IT 负载 48MW。当前公开线索未提供可独立核验的规划决定链接、项目主体、土地权益、融资、客户或开工日期；本条只记录单一媒体报道，不将 48MW 计作已签约、在建或投运容量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 14 that a west London project received construction approval. Citing planning documents, it described up to roughly 50,000 square meters, 64 MW of electricity demand and 48 MW of critical IT load. The public lead does not provide a separately verifiable planning decision, project sponsor, land control, financing, customer or construction date. This is a single-source report only and does not treat 48 MW as contracted, under-construction or operating capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 规划决定与项目主体待核验
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · planning decision and project sponsor unverified
officialResponse: 截至本轮复核，未找到可对应的规划主管部门决定、项目方公告或融资/租约文件。
officialResponseEn: By this review, no matching planning-authority decision, project announcement, financing or lease filing had been located.
sourceNote: 面积、64MW 用电和 48MW IT 口径均来自 Data Center Dynamics 对规划文件的单一转述；容量状态未获一手确认。
sourceNoteEn: The area, 64 MW electricity figure and 48 MW IT figure all come from Data Center Dynamics' single-source account of planning documents; capacity status lacks primary confirmation.

title: Groq 据报融资 3.5 亿美元，英伟达拟参与
titleEn: Groq is reported to have raised $350M with planned Nvidia participation
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 18 日报道称，Groq 融资 3.5 亿美元、估值 35 亿美元，由 Disruptive 领投，英伟达拟参与；报道称 Groq 目前在多区域运营 13 座数据中心、约 54MW 算力，并希望在 2027 年扩至 200MW 以上。Groq 最新可访问的公司公告是 6 月 22 日公布 6.5 亿美元融资并称目标到 2027 年达到 200MW，未看到对本轮 3.5 亿美元或英伟达参与的同步披露。两项数字可能对应不同轮次，当前不能合并或互相替代；200MW 是目标而非已建成容量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 18 that Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation, led by Disruptive with planned Nvidia participation; it said Groq operates 13 data centers across regions with about 54 MW of compute and aims for more than 200 MW in 2027. Groq's latest accessible company announcement is a June 22 $650 million round that also targets 200 MW by 2027; no matching issuer disclosure for the reported $350 million or Nvidia participation was found. The figures may describe different rounds and cannot be combined or substituted; 200 MW is a target, not built capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 与既有公司披露关系待核验
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · relationship to prior issuer disclosure unverified
officialResponse: Groq 最新可访问的公司新闻稿为 6 月 22 日的 6.5 亿美元融资；截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到其对 3.5 亿美元新融资或英伟达拟参与的公开确认。
officialResponseEn: Groq's latest accessible company release is its June 22 $650 million financing; by this scan's cutoff, no public confirmation was found for a new $350 million round or planned Nvidia participation.
sourceNote: DCD 页面仅显示 8 月 18 日，未显示发稿时刻或时区。3.5 亿美元、估值、54MW 与英伟达拟参与均为单一报道；必须由 Groq、投资方或监管文件澄清其与 6 月融资的关系。
sourceNoteEn: The DCD page shows August 18 but no publication time or timezone. The $350 million, valuation, 54 MW and planned Nvidia participation are from one report and require clarification from Groq, investors or a filing against the June financing.

title: Goodman 位于日本筑波的 Tsukuba Tech Central 据报签下 50MW、20 年期超大规模云客户租约
titleEn: Goodman's Tsukuba Tech Central is reported to have signed a 20-year, 50 MW hyperscaler lease
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 19 日报道称，未具名超大规模云客户已为 Goodman 在日本筑波的 Tsukuba Tech Central 签订 50MW、20 年期租约，首期预计 2028 年初 ready for service。Goodman 的公开项目页确认该园区首期为 50MW、整体最多 1,000MW，且处于建设中待出租状态；但未点名客户，也未确认报道所称租约期限或交付时间。因此 50MW 仅是媒体所述的租赁规模，1,000MW 是项目方的最终规划能力，不等同于已投运或已交付容量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 19 that an unnamed hyperscaler signed a 20-year lease for 50 MW at Goodman's Tsukuba Tech Central in Japan, with the first phase expected ready for service in early 2028. Goodman's public project page confirms a 50 MW first phase and an up-to-1,000 MW campus that is under construction and for lease, but does not identify a tenant or confirm the reported lease term or delivery date. The 50 MW is therefore only the media-reported lease scope, while 1,000 MW is the owner's ultimate planned power capacity—not operating or delivered capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 客户、租约与交付日期待核验
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · tenant, lease and delivery date unverified
officialResponse: Goodman 的公开项目页确认首期 50MW、园区整体最多 1,000MW 且处于建设中待出租状态，但未点名客户，也未确认 20 年租约或 2028 年初交付。
officialResponseEn: Goodman's public project page confirms a 50 MW first phase and an up-to-1,000 MW campus under construction and for lease, but does not name a tenant or confirm a 20-year lease or early-2028 delivery.
sourceNote: 客户身份、20 年期限和 2028 年初 RFS 仅来自 DCD 单一报道；不得将规划中的 1,000MW 写作已签约、已送电或已投运容量。
sourceNoteEn: The tenant identity, 20-year term and early-2028 RFS appear only in DCD's single report; the planned 1,000 MW must not be described as leased, energized or operational capacity.

title: Core Scientific 据报完成 Polaris DS 收购，拟扩建俄克拉何马州 Muskogee 园区
titleEn: Core Scientific is reported to have completed its Polaris DS acquisition for a Muskogee expansion
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 18 日报道称，Core Scientific 已完成收购 Polaris DS，取得约 40 英亩土地及最多 440MW 的现有供电协议，报道给出的现金价值为 4.44 亿美元；公司据报计划把相邻的 Muskogee 园区扩至 1.5GW 总电力与 1GW 可租赁电力。Core Scientific 5 月的 8-K 确认过拟议收购及相应土地、供电协议，但截至本轮扫描截止时间，尚未找到对应的完成交割公告或最新监管文件。报道中的 1.5GW / 1GW 是扩建计划，不是已建成或已投运容量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 18 that Core Scientific completed its acquisition of Polaris DS, obtaining about 40 acres and existing service agreements for up to 440 MW; the report gave a $444 million cash value and said the adjacent Muskogee campus is planned to reach 1.5 GW of gross power and 1 GW of leasable power. Core Scientific's May 8-K confirmed the proposed acquisition, land and service agreements, but no matching closing announcement or current filing was located by this scan's cutoff. The 1.5 GW / 1 GW figures are expansion plans, not built or operating capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 交割文件待核验
officialResponse: Core Scientific 5 月的 8-K 确认过拟议收购、土地和最多 440MW 的供电协议；截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到公司就交割完成的对应公告或最新监管文件。
officialResponseEn: Core Scientific's May 8-K confirmed the proposed acquisition, land and service agreements for up to 440 MW; by this scan's cutoff, no matching company closing announcement or current regulatory filing had been located.
sourceNote: DCD 页面仅显示 8 月 18 日，未显示发稿时刻或时区。收购完成、4.44 亿美元价值及扩建目标均来自单一报道；不得将计划容量计入已交付或投运。
sourceNoteEn: The DCD page shows August 18 but no publication time or timezone. The reported closing, $444 million value and expansion targets come from one report and must not be counted as delivered or operating capacity.

title: DataVita 据报获 3 亿英镑债务融资，用于扩建 North Lanarkshire 园区
titleEn: DataVita is reported to have secured a £300M debt facility for its North Lanarkshire campus expansion
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 18 日报道称，DataVita 获得 3 亿英镑债务融资，用于扩建其位于苏格兰 North Lanarkshire 的数据中心园区，资金将用于两栋建筑。公开线索未披露贷款人、期限、提款条件、建筑规模、MW、客户或投运时间；融资额度不能换算为已交付容量或已支付建设资本开支。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 18 that DataVita secured a £300 million debt facility to expand its data-center campus in North Lanarkshire, Scotland, with the funds intended for two buildings. The public lead does not disclose lenders, tenor, draw conditions, building size, megawatts, customers or an operating date; a debt-facility amount cannot be converted into delivered capacity or paid construction capex.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 融资条款与园区规模待披露
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · financing terms and campus scale undisclosed
officialResponse: 截至本轮扫描截止时间，未找到 DataVita 或融资方对应的公开融资公告、条款或项目容量文件。
officialResponseEn: By this scan's cutoff, no matching public financing announcement, terms or project-capacity document was located from DataVita or a financing party.
sourceNote: DCD 的融资金额及两栋建筑用途为单一报道；未披露 MW、客户、提款或投运节点。
sourceNoteEn: The debt amount and use for two buildings come from one DCD report; megawatts, customers, drawdowns and operating milestones are not disclosed.

title: Naver 据报投资海上波浪能数据中心公司 Panthalassa
titleEn: Naver is reported to have invested in offshore wave-powered data-center company Panthalassa
summary: Data Center Dynamics 8 月 14 日报道称，Naver 投资美国海上波浪能数据中心公司 Panthalassa，后者目标是在 2027 年将其波浪能方案商业化。报道未披露投资金额、持股比例、项目地点、数据中心 MW、并网/海上许可或客户合同，也未找到 Naver 或 Panthalassa 对本轮交易的公开公告。本条不把“2027 年商业化目标”视为已获许可、已融资或已投运电力容量。
summaryEn: Data Center Dynamics reported on August 14 that Naver invested in US offshore wave-powered data-center company Panthalassa, which targets commercialization of its wave-power solution in 2027. The report does not disclose investment size, ownership, project location, data-center megawatts, grid or offshore permits, or customer contracts, and no public announcement of this round was located from Naver or Panthalassa. The 2027 commercialization target is not treated as permitted, financed or operating power capacity.
statusLabel: 单一媒体报道 · 投资与项目参数待披露
statusLabelEn: Single-source report · investment and project parameters undisclosed
officialResponse: 截至本轮复核，未找到 Naver 或 Panthalassa 的本轮投资公告、许可文件或容量/客户披露。
officialResponseEn: By this review, no investment announcement, permit filing, capacity disclosure or customer disclosure was located from Naver or Panthalassa.
sourceNote: Naver 投资和 2027 年商业化目标来自 Data Center Dynamics 单一报道；该技术路线仍需以项目、许可和电力交付材料核验。
sourceNoteEn: The Naver investment and 2027 commercialization target come from one Data Center Dynamics report; project, permitting and power-delivery records are still needed for verification.

title: NVIDIA 与 Cloverleaf 合作并进行少数股权投资，具体条款未披露
titleEn: NVIDIA partners with Cloverleaf and makes a minority investment; terms remain undisclosed
summary: Cloverleaf 通过 PR Newswire 8 月 21 日公司供稿称，NVIDIA 已与其建立战略合作并进行少数股权投资，以支持美国 AI 工厂基础设施建设；Reuters 同日援引双方称 NVIDIA 已完成少数投资。公告未披露投资金额、持股比例、项目清单、MW 或交付时间，NVIDIA 自有新闻室/IR 页面也未找到完整交易条款。
summaryEn: A Cloverleaf company-supplied release carried by PR Newswire on August 21 said NVIDIA entered a strategic partnership and made a minority investment to support U.S. AI-factory infrastructure. Reuters reported the same day, citing the companies, that NVIDIA had made the minority investment. No amount, ownership percentage, project list, MW figure or delivery timing was disclosed, and no complete deal terms were located on NVIDIA’s own newsroom or IR pages.
statusLabel: 公司供稿 + 媒体报道 · 条款未确认
statusLabelEn: Company-supplied release + media report · terms unconfirmed
entities: 美国数据中心基础设施
officialResponse: Cloverleaf 的公司供稿确认合作和少数投资这一说法，但未给出交易条款；截至本轮截止时间，未找到 NVIDIA 自有公告、SEC 文件或项目/公用事业记录确认金额、持股、具体站点、容量或交付安排。
officialResponseEn: Cloverleaf’s company-supplied release supports the existence of a partnership and minority investment, but gives no deal terms. By this cutoff, no NVIDIA-owned announcement, SEC filing or project/utility record was located to confirm amount, ownership, sites, capacity or delivery arrangements.
sourceNote: PR Newswire 是公司供稿分发渠道，Reuters 为独立媒体报道；两者不构成两个独立一手来源。条目保留在 Rumor Watch，不升级为已核验并购、融资或容量记录。
sourceNoteEn: PR Newswire is a company-supplied distribution channel and Reuters is independent media; they are not two independent primary sources. The item remains in Rumor Watch rather than becoming a verified M&A, financing or capacity record.
